start: Gym owner on Settings → Branding with a saved logo that has a clear colour

steps.action: In the "Colour" card tap "Suggest a colour from my logo"
user_sees: A box "Colour from your logo" with an "Aa" sample, the colour code and "Use this colour"
must_not: The logo sent to an AI or another server
A colour not in the logo

user_sees: "Easy to read on the member app’s dark screens." or "Too dark to read…"
"Prints clearly as the coloured bar on the white member ID card." or "Prints pale…"
"Members see it after you press Save."
must_not: A tick next to a colour that is too dark

user_sees: The button reads "Using this colour" and greys out; "Your brand colour" holds the code; the phone preview changes; "Saving…"
must_not: The colour saved before Save is pressed
A different code saved from the one shown

start: Gym owner on Branding uploads a new logo

user_sees: While it uploads, the colours are read; the box "Colour from your logo" appears with no extra tap
must_not: The upload fails because the colours could not be read

steps.action: Under "Other colours in your logo" tap a swatch
user_sees: The swatch is marked; the brand colour field holds that code
must_not: The main suggestion button still saying "Using this colour"

steps.action: With no logo, look at the Colour card
user_sees: No suggest button; only "Your brand colour"

steps.action: With a black-and-white logo tap "Suggest a colour from my logo"
user_sees: "Your logo is only black, white or grey, so there is no colour to suggest. Type or pick your colour below."
must_not: Grey offered as the brand colour

steps.action: With a logo that cannot be read, tap it
user_sees: "We couldn’t read the colours in this logo. Type or pick your colour below."

start: Gym owner used the suggested colour

steps.action: Type another colour in "Your brand colour"
user_sees: The suggestion button reads "Use this colour" again
must_not: "Using this colour" while another colour is in the field
The old logo's colours still offered

steps.action: A logo whose colour is too dark
user_sees: "Your logo’s colour is <code>. We made it lighter so words in it are easy to read on the member app’s dark screens."
must_not: The lighter colour shown without saying it was changed
